verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a self-serve seller path: onboard as a seller in the Dashboard, review an agent's terms, and send an approval request that the agent accepts. Merchants can also publish a payment-gated endpoint for machine payments that returns an HTTP 402 challenge. The caveats are real: ACS is labelled private preview and limited to certain regions, the custom checkout-endpoint path requires a waitlist, and listing in ChatGPT requires applying. missing for 10: ungated general availability (no private preview or waitlist), broader geographic availability, independent hands-on corroboration of merchant onboarding.

support.subject: As a merchant, I have a documented self-serve path to start accepting agent traffic — enable a setting, sign an agreement, or publish an endpoint

citations.quote: Use Agentic Commerce Suite (ACS) to start selling through agents with a single integration.
Find the agent you want to sell through and review its terms
We send the agent an approval request that the agent must accept
Your server returns a payment challenge, the agent presents a valid payment credential, and Stripe settles the payment to your Stripe balance.
